upd3.restartHint: Downloads pause safely and resume by themselves once XENO STORE is back.
upd3.restartConfirm: XENO STORE restarts with the new version. It takes about 10 seconds; your downloads continue afterwards.

saves3.autoResign: Re-signed to your account and placed in the game automatically
saves3.optionsDesc: Backup drive, nickname, save feeds and upload host

link.title: Link to your PS5
link.text: This browser isn't linked to your PS5 yet. Link it once, then browse, download and send games to your PS5 from here.
link.step2: Your PS5 shows a 6-digit code in a notification
link.shown: Code sent — look at the notification on your PS5
link.wait: Wait {n} s before showing it again
link.bad: That code isn't right — check the notification on your PS5
link.note: Only devices you link can control your store. You do this once per browser.

diag2.crashLastRun: XENO STORE stopped unexpectedly last time and restarted on its own. If it happens again, copy this report and send it in.
diag2.crashOlder: An earlier session stopped with this problem.
diag2.safeMode: Safe start: automatic background checks are paused for this session.

gameapp.title: XENO STORE app
gameapp.sub: The app tile under Games. The store downloads it into /data/homebrew and ShadowMountPlus adds the tile — no FTP needed.
gameapp.folderCopy: Installed as the folder /data/homebrew/PPSA99500, which XENO STORE does not update. Remove that folder to install the published version here, or keep updating it yourself.
gameapp.already: The app is already being installed
gameapp.doneDesc: The XENO STORE tile appears under Games within about a minute (ShadowMountPlus rescans on its own). If it doesn't, restart the console with your jailbreak and ShadowMountPlus loaded.
gameapp.hintTitle: Put XENO STORE on your Games row
gameapp.hintText: Install the app once and open the store from its own tile — no FTP, no browser address.
gameapp.openOnStart: Open XENO STORE when it starts
gameapp.openOnStartHint: Opens the store on the TV each time it starts. Turn it off if you auto-start the store at boot.

err.sha256_mismatch: The download didn't match its checksum — nothing was installed. Try again.
err.sha256_unavailable: The release has no checksum yet — try again in a few minutes.
err.no_space: Not enough free space on the internal drive.
err.not_package: The download is not an app image.
err.too_large: The download is larger than expected — nothing was installed.
err.download_failed: The download failed. Check the console's internet connection and try again.
